description: Image Description: The image shows a traditional, cylindrical outdoor oven made of a rough, cracked clay or mud-like material with a domed top. The surface of the oven is weathered and charred in places, indicating frequent use over time. The front of the oven features a metal door that is open, revealing the interior. Inside, there are visible flames burning brightly, suggesting an active fire used for heating or cooking. The fire consists of wood logs and embers, with orange and yellow flames
